summary: 5 scheduled changes (c001-c005) plus c006 tracked-but-blocked. Apply c001 first: it is the only change with no prerequisite, and c002->c003->c004 is a hard chain where each supplies state the next needs (instance ownership -> drainable writer -> atomic checkpoint -> the consumer relying on all three). c005 runs in parallel — the met/gap/void defect is in the evidence model, not the replication path. Adversarial review took the plan from 3 CRITICAL to 0: it split the materializer into c004 (schema-agnostic, proceeds now) and c006 (concrete clinical tables, blocked on ASO's unpublished schema), added the P1 spec-delta requirement the first draft omitted, and forced a DONE-vs-PROVEN distinction. All findings addressed; none carried.

Every change lands DONE (implemented, spec-valid, tests authored) but NOT PROVEN (tests unexecuted) per the no-testing directive. No change may be reported as verified or certified.
